name: add_terraform_iam_policy_scoped_to_bucket
description: Add a least-privilege aws_iam_policy for read-only access to an existing S3 bucket, proven by real terraform validate; broken scopes Resource to a bare wildcard "*" instead of the bucket's own ARN, granting access to every bucket in the account
prompts: main.tf declares an aws_s3_bucket named reports with no IAM policy at all - nothing currently grants any principal access to it. Add an aws_iam_policy resource named reports_read_only that allows the s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket actions, scoped ONLY to this bucket: Resource must reference aws_s3_bucket.reports.arn (for ListBucket) and "${aws_s3_bucket.reports.arn}/*" (for GetObject) - never a bare wildcard "*", which would grant access to every bucket in the AWS account. Run `terraform fmt`. Do not modify the existing aws_s3_bucket resource or the environment variable.

test_setup_files.check_iam_policy.py:
import json
import re
import subprocess

fmt = subprocess.run(["terraform", "fmt", "-check", "-diff"], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert fmt.returncode == 0, f"terraform fmt -check failed:\n{fmt.stdout}\n{fmt.stderr}"

init = subprocess.run(["terraform", "init", "-backend=false", "-input=false"],
                      capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
assert init.returncode == 0, f"terraform init failed:\n{init.stdout}\n{init.stderr}"

validate = subprocess.run(["terraform", "validate", "-no-color", "-json"],
                          capture_output=True, text=True)
data = json.loads(validate.stdout)
assert data.get("valid") is True, f"terraform validate failed: {validate.stdout}\n{validate.stderr}"

content = open("main.tf", encoding="utf-8").read()

m = re.search(r'resource\s+"aws_iam_policy"[^{]*\{(.*)\}\s*$', content, re.DOTALL)
assert m, "no aws_iam_policy resource"
body = m.group(1)

assert "s3:GetObject" in body, "policy is missing s3:GetObject"
assert "s3:ListBucket" in body, "policy is missing s3:ListBucket"

# the whole point: Resource must be scoped to THIS bucket's arn, not "*"
# (which would grant access to every bucket in the account)
assert re.search(r'Resource\s*=\s*"\*"', body) is None, (
    "policy Resource is a bare wildcard \"*\" - this grants access to every S3 bucket in the "
    "account, not just aws_s3_bucket.reports")
assert "aws_s3_bucket.reports.arn" in body, (
    "policy Resource does not reference aws_s3_bucket.reports.arn - it must be scoped to this "
    "bucket specifically")

# the original bucket resource must survive untouched
assert re.search(r'resource\s+"aws_s3_bucket"\s+"reports"\s*\{', content), "bucket resource lost"

print("PASS terraform IAM least-privilege checks")
